title: Pascal-crossing pair: every carry of the first 36 phases checked in Lean, so the 3/2 reset map holds there with no assumption
text: The reset map X → ⌊3X/2⌋+1 or +3 was proved for the head of the tape, given that every carry into the tail comes back. A run-length simulator whose left side ends in an arbitrary tape, proved move by move for every such tape, now runs each carry of each phase on the real tail; native_decide checks the first 26 phases of both machines in CI and 36 by hand (X = 93,454,756 here, about 4·10<sup>16</sup> steps). Halting is still open: the check costs 1.5 times more each phase, and no property of the tail alone keeps the carries safe.
